title: Phosphate, refeeding and tumour lysis
regimen: Feed slowly + supplement Mg, PO₄, K · TLS: NaCl 0.9% 1 L 6–8-hourly + allopurinol
dagger_note: † = clinical or local addition, not in the SA STG. Any item without a source page is †; items with a page are from the cited guideline.
item_format: Items: t=text, x=detail, s=source 'source-id:printed page' (STG pages are chapter.page), s_more=extra refs, d=1 dagger, b=1 bold. steps[].actions[] are the ordered spine (flow view); steps[].sequence.rows[].cells[] are ordered fluid/drug cells (m=a/b/c); steps[].decisions[] are IF/then branches; reference.blocks[] are tables (cols/rows) or lists (items).

items.t: Hypophosphataemia when re-fed too fast with high-carbohydrate feeds; starts within 4 days
Respiratory / cardiac failure, arrhythmias, rhabdomyolysis, seizures, coma
PO₄ >1.45, K >6.0, Ca <1.75, urate >0.476 mmol/L, azotaemia
TLS: no diuretics if normal heart/kidneys; never if hypovolaemic
TLS + high Na or overload → consult
IV phosphate binds Ca: separate lines; watch Ca, K

actions.t: Flag: little intake >5–10 days, BMI <16, weight loss >15%, alcohol, low K/PO₄/Mg
Check PO₄, Mg, K, glucose before feeding
Start feeds slowly with aggressive Mg, PO₄, K supplementation
Oral feeding preferred; NGT next; TPN only exceptionally
Daily PO₄, Mg, K, glucose; watch for oedema, arrhythmia

steps.title: Replace phosphate
steps.subtitle: oral if mild · IV if severe
steps.sequence_order: a grade ▶ b replace ▶ c recheck 6–12-hourly

steps.title: Tumour lysis: hydrate and protect kidneys
steps.subtitle: fluid · allopurinol · lytes

actions.t: Allopurinol 100 mg 8-hourly (max 300 mg 8-hourly; 50 mg if eGFR <20)
Treat high K (Hyperkalaemia card) and low Ca (Ca card); transfer to oncology

blocks.note: Potassium phosphate 15% contains 2 mmol/mL K (PAED 23.15) — count the potassium. Give over ≥6 h.
